_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your own data. config.json is gitignored — your personal info never leaves your machine.
_language_options: auto = decide per service (German TLD / German mail content -> German letter), or force 'de' / 'en'
_supervisory_authority_hint: Optional: name your local data protection authority (e.g. 'LfDI Baden-Wuerttemberg'). Left empty, the letters just say 'the competent supervisory authority'.
_profile_path_hint: Optional: explicit path to your Thunderbird/Betterbird profile folder. Leave empty for auto-discovery.

accounts._password_hint: Leave empty to be prompted at send time, or set the FPD_SMTP_PASSWORD environment variable. For Gmail/Outlook use an app password.
